references.text: Balaam also told the Moabite messengers to stay overnight the first time they came, so that he could hear what the Lord would say to him.
God comes to Balaam at night and gives him further instructions, which is the direct answer to Balaam's request in verse 19.
Balaam seeks the Lord's word again and waits for God to reveal Himself to him, a recurring pattern from chapter 22.
Balaam confirms that he can say nothing other than what the Lord speaks to him, showing his dependence on God's word.
God comes to Laban at night with a message, similar to how God communicates with Balaam at night.
Samuel waits to hear more from the Lord, in the same way that Balaam waits for further revelation from God.
